economy.summary: Supports raising Pennsylvania's minimum wage to $15 per hour, noting the state minimum has stayed at $7.25 for 16 years and is the lowest among neighboring states; also backs affordable-housing proposals including closing-cost help for first-time homebuyers and a home repair fund.
economy.short: Supports $15 minimum wage and affordable-housing investments.

taxes.summary: Voted for the 2025-26 $50.1 billion state budget, saying it delivers investments to public schools and essential programs without adding any new tax burden on residents and without tapping the state's emergency fund.
taxes.short: Voted for 2025-26 state budget; says no new taxes.

abortion.summary: Says she is pro-choice and that reproductive freedoms must be ensured in all forms, pledging to guard against any stripping away of access to a safe abortion in Pennsylvania.
abortion.short: Says she is pro-choice; pledges to protect abortion access.

education.summary: Says correcting Pennsylvania's public school funding system, which a court declared unconstitutional, needs to be the top priority; supports moving away from property-tax-dependent school funding and co-sponsored legislation to reform charter school funding.
education.short: Prioritizes school funding reform; co-sponsored charter funding legislation.

healthcare.summary: Co-sponsored House Bill 78 of 2023, which would establish a state Medical Debt Relief Program and hospital financial-assistance requirements; the bill passed the House in June 2023. Her campaign lists preventing medical emergencies from trapping people in debt as a priority.
healthcare.short: Co-sponsored medical debt relief bill; prioritizes preventing medical debt.

energy.summary: Says Pennsylvania must participate in a program to limit greenhouse gas emissions, whether RGGI or another program, and that regulating air quality at the county level makes no sense because air does not stay stationary above a county.
energy.short: Supports joining RGGI or similar emissions-limiting program.

guns.summary: Co-sponsored House Bill 714 of 2023, which would expand background checks to private sales of long guns; the bill passed the House in May 2023 and was referred to the Senate.
guns.short: Co-sponsored bill expanding background checks to private long-gun sales.
